verdict.rationale: Online filing constraints are a fair question for a government e-filing service, so the axis applies. The pack shows the account, MFA, and identity-verification requirement stated up front (uspto-supp-1), plus a fallback for when the system is unavailable on a deadline day (uspto-docs-22). Neither publishes an operating-hours window, a per-day filing limit, or a session timeout, and nothing else in the pack does.
